entities.name: PMID:25429050
observations: Gut 2015 primary study tested mesalazine and thymoquinone for 43 weeks in Msh2^loxP/loxP Villin-Cre mice.
Control tumor incidence was 94%; mesalazine reduced incidence to 69% (p=0.04) and thymoquinone to 56% (p=0.003).
Mean tumor multiplicity was 3.1 tumors/mouse in controls, 1.4 with mesalazine (p=0.004), and 1.1 with thymoquinone (p<0.001).
Mesalazine and thymoquinone reduced microsatellite instability in normal intestinal tissue; thymoquinone, but not mesalazine, reduced tumor MSI.
